result.title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
result.summary: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

AI.brief_summary: 本文对两个 System-1 决策模型（开权重 Laya 与托管 Jev）在 11 类 agent 决策点上做配对、自审计评测，覆盖工具选择、检索相关性门控与提示注入检测，并披露自家分析中的偏差与部署成本误算。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「慢证据、快决策」的取舍、选项顺序敏感性与候选数量导致的性能退化，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡、证据筛选与延迟预算提供外部参照；但研究对象是 agent harness 的门控分类器，与多模态 latent 推理状态无直接关系，需核查其结论可迁移性。
